name: Boots for the Guard
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: The mounted division of the Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of ornate mithril boots.  Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing II
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing II
